technology_selection.reason: lowest-risk fit for the current PowerShell-centric Windows package while retaining explicit upgrade, repair, uninstall and privilege policy controls

lifecycle_contract.fresh_install: stage immutable application files separately from owner configuration and secrets
lifecycle_contract.upgrade: preserve supported owner configuration and secret bindings unless explicit migration is required
lifecycle_contract.migration: fail closed on unknown layout or unsupported schema; never infer or expose secret values
lifecycle_contract.repair: repair application-owned files only; do not overwrite owner configuration or secret state by default
lifecycle_contract.uninstall: remove application-owned files and shortcuts; preserve owner configuration/secrets unless the user explicitly opts in to delete them
lifecycle_contract.rollback: future implementation must define an atomic or recoverable rollback boundary before replacing an existing supported installation

must_explain: what the user can do next
